name: v63_sh_equity_guidance_band
hypothesis: A high shareholder-equity guidance midpoint with a narrow guidance band may capture balance-sheet confidence outside EPS, FCF, EV valuation, accounting-cleanliness, and price-reversal families.
expression: 0.42 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.19 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_number, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Analyst balance-sheet guidance probe; no FCF, EV, option, news/product graph, relationship return, close/open, tax/SBP/lease cleanliness.

name: v63_sh_equity_guidance_improvement
hypothesis: Improving shareholder-equity guidance may be more orthogonal than the level signal and less tied to existing EPSR/FCF actives.
expression: 0.38 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 63), 126), industry) + 0.27 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_low) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Change-oriented sh-equity guidance; watch Fitness and corr vs LLpZgaeL/P0pgZllw.

name: v63_sh_equity_actual_delivery
hypothesis: Shareholder-equity actuals above analyst estimates may capture balance-sheet delivery distinct from sales/EPS/FCF delivery.
expression: 0.42 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_value / anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_mean, 126), industry) + 0.23 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_value / anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_mean, 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_number, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_90_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Repairs weak prior sh-equity delivery by using annual advanced fields and MARKET neutralization; no price/value term.

name: v63_bvps_actual_with_equity_delivery
hypothesis: Book value per share actuals combined with shareholder-equity delivery may form a balance-sheet value signal, but it must pass strict corr checks versus ordinary value and FCF actives.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_bvps_value / close, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_number, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Controlled book-value probe; reject if it becomes ordinary value/high corr with P0pgZllw or RRpm5LEo.

name: v63_netdebt_equity_expectation
hypothesis: Low net-debt actuals relative to estimates paired with positive shareholder-equity guidance may capture balance-sheet repair without using tax/SBP/lease cleanliness.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_netdebt_value / anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netdebt_mean, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netdebt_number, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)

name: v63_total_assets_compact_equity_ratio
hypothesis: Lower expected total-asset growth plus higher expected equity/assets may capture conservative asset growth rather than accounting-cleanliness or profitability.
expression: 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_totassets_mean / assets, 63), 126), industry) + 0.26 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_mean / anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_totassets_mean, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_totassets_std / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Conservative balance-sheet expectation probe; avoids tax/SBP/lease and ordinary operating profitability.

name: v63_ptp_estimate_subindustry_repair
hypothesis: The v62/v50 pretax estimate seed has enough Sharpe but marginal corr; subindustry grouping and lower level weight may preserve signal while reducing overlap with EPSR and reported FCF actives.
expression: 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ptp_mean / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ptp_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ptp_low) / abs(assets), 126), subindustry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ptp_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Strict corr gate vs LLpZgaeL/P0pgZllw; do not rescue if corr remains above 0.68.

name: v63_ebit_guidance_band
hypothesis: EBIT guidance midpoint with narrow guidance band may be a non-EPS operating expectation signal, separate from FCF/EV valuation.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ebit_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ebit_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ebit_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ebit_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_number, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_90_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Annual EBIT guidance, not EBITDA/EV; expected to be weak if guidance fields are noisy.

name: v63_short_interest_relief_pure
hypothesis: Low and falling short interest may be independent if not stabilized by operating profitability, option flow, or social/news filters.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_short_interest, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(news_short_interest, 63), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Pure short-interest probe after v59 short-interest weakness; stop if Sharpe/Fitness remains low.

name: v63_credit_facility_short_relief
hypothesis: Low credit-facility utilization plus remaining capacity and low short interest may capture balance-sheet liquidity without tax/SBP/lease cleanliness.
expression: 0.38 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * credit_facility_outstanding_amount / credit_facility_max_borrowing, 126), industry) + 0.27 * group_rank(ts_rank(credit_facility_remaining_borrowing_capacity / credit_facility_max_borrowing, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_short_interest, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Credit capacity + short relief; no FCF, EV, tax/SBP/lease, product graph, or price reversal.
